svg.title: DPP5.0 maturity ladder: document, data, semantics, verifiable claims, evidence graph
svg.desc: Spherity research maturity model: DPP1.0 document, DPP2.0 structured data, DPP3.0 semantic product data, DPP4.0 signed issuer-bound claims, and DPP5.0 access-controlled evidence graphs. Based on page 26 of the original 36-page visual paper; adapted by removing slide numbering and footer while preserving explanatory diagrams.
